answer: A practical Sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation with decay. Each agent locks a refundable deposit and earns reputation only through verified work, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real capital per identity instead of nothing. Peers at each vertex of the trust graph verify a cipher-signed proof of prior service before accepting new claims, and deposits are slashed when an identity double-signs. Like wind shaping a dune, honest history builds slowly while cheap copies erode, so an attacker must outspend the honest network to fake a majority.
